title: 36 Hours in Nashville
abstract: Flourishing art and food scenes, and musical venues that celebrate new voices are just a few of the reasons to visit this ever-evolving city.

title: 36 Hours in Athens
abstract: From the ancient Acropolis to a daring Renzo Piano-designed cultural center, the Greek capital is luring record numbers of tourists to explore its monuments, new and old.

title: 36 Hours in Chicago
abstract: Culture, comedy and culinary outings in the ever-evolving Loop district and beyond.

title: 36 Hours in Singapore
abstract: Yes, there are futuristic mega malls and skyscrapers. But you’ll also find a rich cultural heritage reflected in traditional temples and shrines, street food and homegrown art.
